guide.industrialcrops.start.welcome.body:
Industrial Crops turns farming into a factory. You start with a single field, convert vanilla crops into industrial crops, then feed the harvest into machines, storage networks and power grids.

This manual follows that path chapter by chapter. Use the tabs on the left to jump between chapters and the arrows below to turn pages. Lost it? Craft a new one from a Book, Wheat Seeds and a Copper Ingot.
guide.industrialcrops.start.roadmap.body:
Progress is measured in device casings. Each tier unlocks the next set of machines:

• Copper: crop conversion, compression, mixing and basic crop storage.
• Iron: manipulation devices, pipes, crop analysis and slime machines.
• Gold: components, bio-energy, power grids and matter data.
• Crystal Steel: plasma, 5×5 crafting and wireless machines.
• Paradox Steel: Carrote technology and stable matter.
guide.industrialcrops.start.tips.title: Reading the Machines
guide.industrialcrops.start.tips.body:
Hold Shift over any machine in your inventory to read what it does. Most machine screens explain their slots with short hints.

With JEI installed, every special recipe in this mod (conversion, manipulation, mixing, programming, crystal workbench) is listed in its own category. Advancements under the Industrial Crops tab mark each milestone described in this manual.

Hover an item in this manual to see its name; the panel on the right shows its recipe when one exists.
Three things get your farm started:

• Redstone Bonemeal: 8 Redstone around 1 Bone Meal makes 4. Every crop conversion uses one.
• Empty Bags: 8 Paper around 1 String makes 4. Bags carry seeds and harvests.
• Copper Device Casing: Copper Ingots and Planks. It is the frame of every copper-tier machine.
guide.industrialcrops.crops.conversion.b:
The Basic Crop Conversion Device turns vanilla crops into industrial ones. Load the crop, a Redstone Bonemeal and, when required, an Empty Bag.

• Carrot / Potato → Bagged Industrial Carrot / Potato
• Wheat → Industrial Wheat; Hay Bale → Industrial Wheat Block
• Wheat, Melon or Pumpkin Seeds → Bagged Industrial Seeds
• Melon / Pumpkin block → Industrial Melon / Pumpkin

Converted crops start at Normal, Good or Excellent quality.
guide.industrialcrops.crops.growing.body:
Plant Industrial Carrots and Potatoes directly on farmland; plant bagged seeds the same way. A Bagged Industrial Carrot or Potato can also be unpacked into a single crop in the crafting grid.

Right-click a mature Industrial Carrot or Potato with an Empty Bag to collect one bagged crop: the plant resets and keeps growing, no replanting needed. On other mature industrial crops, a bag extracts 3–6 seeds once.

A Rapid Growth Fertilizer Bag finishes an industrial crop instantly.
guide.industrialcrops.crops.compress.bod:
The Crop Compressor packs 64 identical industrial crops into one crop block. Blocks save space and are worth far more energy later (3,200 FE each in a bio-energy generator).

Use a Fertile Soil Fertilizer Bag on farmland to turn it into Fertile Soil. Fertile Soil never dries out or degrades, and industrial crops planted on it give double harvests. Convert your whole field early.
guide.industrialcrops.crops.mixer.title: The Mixer
guide.industrialcrops.crops.mixer.body:
Right-click the Mixer with ingredients and an Empty Bag to load it; right-click with an empty hand to take the product.

• Bone Meal + Industrial Wheat + Sugar → Rapid Growth Fertilizer
• Dirt + Bone Meal + Industrial Wheat → Fertile Soil Fertilizer
• 2 Industrial Wheat (+2 Redstone / Sugar / Golden Carrot / Iron) → Normal, Rapid Breeding, Rapid Growth, Health Restoration or Resistance Boost Feed Bags

Feed bags work on animals and return the empty bag.
guide.industrialcrops.genetics.quality.b:
Every industrial carrot, potato, wheat, melon and pumpkin carries two quality genes. The dominant gene is the quality you see in the tooltip; the recessive gene is hidden.

Qualities from lowest to highest: Normal, Good, Excellent, Fine, Supreme, Super.

Insert a crop or seed bag into the Crop Analysis Device (iron tier) to read both genes.
Plant the same industrial crop side by side. When a plant matures, its seeds inherit one gene from itself and one from a random neighbour of the same kind.

If both picked genes are recessive, the offspring is promoted at least one tier above the better parent. Keep your best plants together, analyse the results and replant the winners. With patience every line reaches Super.
guide.industrialcrops.genetics.fusion.bo:
Breed an Industrial Melon and an Industrial Pumpkin up to Super quality, then fuse them in the Gourd Modification Device to create a Fusion Melon.

Combine a Fusion Melon with a Stable Matter Ingot (see the Carrote chapter) to make a Fusion Ingot. Three ingots form the Fusion Ingot Pickaxe: automatic Fortune III on ores, Silk Touch on everything else, and it can mine naturally generated unbreakable blocks.
guide.industrialcrops.exotic.exotic_seed:
Prism Pod, Embercoil, Starbloom, Neon Bulb and Fluxstalk are strange new plants.

Prism Pod, Embercoil and Starbloom seeds turn up in vanilla loot chests, and Wandering Traders sometimes sell them. Plant them like any seed; harvests drop more seeds.

Combine an Empty Bag with seeds to bag them. Collecting all five crops completes the An Unusual Garden advancement, and all five are needed for Strange Fertilizer.
guide.industrialcrops.exotic.strange_fer:
Mix one of each exotic crop with an Empty Bag in the Mixer to get a Strange Fertilizer Bag.

Use it on dirt-like blocks to turn them into purple Comet Soil. Apply Bone Meal to Comet Soil with open space above: each attempt has a chance to sprout a Comet Sapling.
Grow the Comet Sapling into a Comet Tree. Its logs make a full set of comet wood building blocks.

Breaking Comet Leaves without shears can drop saplings and, rarely, Comet Essence. Fortune improves both chances. Comet Essence is the key ingredient for the Crystal Steel Workbench and every crystal machine, so start a comet grove before the crystal tier.
guide.industrialcrops.logistics.crop_sto:
Place Basic Storage Components next to a Basic Control Device. Right-click the controller to deposit or withdraw industrial carrots and potatoes in steps of 1 or 64.

Components connect through each other, so you can grow the array in any direction. This early storage only accepts industrial crops.
guide.industrialcrops.logistics.pipes.bo:
A pipe line has three parts:

• Output Pipe: pulls items out of the container it touches.
• Pipe: carries items along the line.
• Input Pipe: pushes items into the container it touches.

Add a Pipe Sorter to route items with a whitelist or blacklist; an empty list lets everything through. Reinforced and Advanced pipes move items faster.
guide.industrialcrops.logistics.manipula:
The Basic Manipulation Device is your iron-tier workshop. Open it, pick a product from the catalog and supply the listed materials.

Its first product is the Iron Device Casing (10 Iron Ingots + 1 Stripped Log), needed for every iron machine. It also builds the Reinforced Control Device and reinforced pipes. Reinforced Storage Components hold 54 oversized stacks each and keep their contents when broken.
guide.industrialcrops.logistics.advanced:
Craft an Upgrade Kit Substrate (2 Comparators, a Redstone Torch, an Iron Ingot), then add five Gold Ingots to make a Gold Upgrade Kit.

Right-click a Basic Manipulation Device with the kit to upgrade it in place into an Advanced Manipulation Device. Its catalog adds advanced pipes, gold fluid pipes, the Advanced Industrial Storage Device and all matter-data machines.
guide.industrialcrops.logistics.componen:
Component Substrate (2 Comparators, a Redstone Torch, a Gold Ingot) is the blank for every component. Load it with materials in the Component Programming Device to program:

• Industrial Storage Components I–IV for network storage
• Speed Components I–IV for faster machines
• Automatic, Guidance, Rapid-Fire and Power Components
• Dimension Upgrades for unlimited or interdimensional range
guide.industrialcrops.logistics.network_:
The Advanced Industrial Storage Device stores any item in Industrial Storage Components, with search and a built-in crafting terminal (JEI recipe transfer works).

A Remote Access Device binds to a controller, storage device or network terminal with a right-click. Use it to open that storage from up to 128 blocks away; install Dimension Upgrade Components in the target for unlimited or cross-dimension access.
guide.industrialcrops.logistics.automati:
The Automatic Sowing Device runs on FE and plants seeds on farmland across a 3×3 chunk area. It takes seeds from its own slots first, then from adjacent containers.

For defence or demolition, the Explosive Potato Launcher fires Explosive Potatoes (Industrial Potato, Gunpowder, Redstone) at the coordinates you enter. It needs a Guidance Component; Rapid-Fire and Power Components upgrade it.
The Component Substrate Integrated Gold Device Casing combines gold, planks and a Component Substrate. It is the base of every powered machine: generators, energy storage, the electric furnace, the extraction device, the sowing device and more.

Tip: once you reach the slime machines, a diamond slime produces Component Substrate for you.
guide.industrialcrops.power.bio_energy.b:
The Bio-Energy Generation Device burns biomass into FE. Each item takes 8 seconds:

• Seeds: 25 FE
• Crops: 50 FE
• Crop blocks: 3,200 FE

Burning leaves residue. When the residue fills up the generator stops, so place an Incinerator next to it (or connect it by pipe) and give it any furnace fuel. It destroys the residue automatically.
guide.industrialcrops.power.grid.title: Building a Grid
guide.industrialcrops.power.grid.body:
Connect generators to machines with Basic Energy Cable; Advanced Energy Cable carries more power. The Gold Energy Storage Cabinet buffers 10,000,000 FE. Open its screen to set each side to input, output or disabled.

Your first big consumer is usually the Electric Furnace, which smelts three batches at once. All devices use standard FE, so power from other mods works too.
guide.industrialcrops.crystal.plasma.bod:
Ripe Energy Bushes give Plasma Fruit when right-clicked. Feed the fruit to a powered Extraction Device to produce Concentrated Plasma Berry Juice.

Store the juice in a Copper Fluid Storage Cabinet, move it with Gold Fluid Pipes, or fill a bucket. A Plasma Juice Bucket can be poured into a cauldron.

Careful: stepping into plasma juice electrocutes you.
guide.industrialcrops.crystal.energy_cry:
Throw a Diamond into plasma juice, either a cauldron or a pool. It transforms into an Energy Crystal.

Craft an Energy Crystal between two Iron Ingots to make a Crystal Ingot. Crystal Ingots, Iron and Planks form the Crystal Steel Casing, the frame of the crystal tier.
Comet Essence, a Crystal Steel Casing, a Crafting Table and a Copper Fluid Storage Cabinet make the Crystal Steel Workbench.

It crafts on a 5×5 grid and has its own fluid tank. Some recipes need fluid in the tank. Fill it with plasma juice before crafting them. JEI shows every workbench recipe, including the fluid it needs.
guide.industrialcrops.crystal.crystal_ma:
The workbench builds the endgame helpers:

• Wireless Logistics Transfer Device: items and fluids between endpoints on the same channel.
• Crafting Processing Device: recursive auto-crafting from your storage.
• Terrain Processing Device: digs or fills whole chunks.
• Automatic Animal Breeder: feeds, breeds and caps livestock.
• Wireless Energy Transfer Device: powers machines in range (needs 1,000 mB plasma).
guide.industrialcrops.crystal.launch_sit:
Build a 3×3×3 launch site. Place the Rocket Launch Site controller, then fill the 3×3 floor behind it with eight Launch Pads and stack Gantry Frames two high on the four corners.

Put a Satellite Rocket (small 2, medium 3 or large 4 blocks tall) on the centre pad with clear sky above. Feed the controller FE and plasma juice, open it and press Launch.

Each satellite in orbit links every powered Satellite Signal Receiver.
guide.industrialcrops.crystal.reaction.b:
Combine an Upgrade Kit Substrate with five Crystal Ingots to make a Crystal Steel Upgrade Kit.

Right-click a Bio-Energy Generation Device with it to upgrade it into a Bio-Energy Reaction Device. It keeps its inventory and stored energy, and every fuel item now produces double the energy.
guide.industrialcrops.matter.digitize.bo:
Build these in the Advanced Manipulation Device. Place an Item Network Management Terminal, then connect a Matter Digitization Device to it.

Insert items into the digitizer and press Upload. They become data stored in the terminal, where you can browse and select them. Only allowed items can be uploaded.
guide.industrialcrops.matter.copy_rebuil:
Select an entry in the terminal, then:

• Data Copying Device: drains a full 10,000 FE charge to add one copy of the selected data. Insert an Automatic Component to keep copying until you click again.
• Matter Reconstruction Device: turns selected data back into a real item at 5 FE per tick.

Together they let you multiply valuable materials with power.
guide.industrialcrops.matter.forest.body:
Connect a Digital Miniature Forest to your item network and select digitized sapling data. It grows a virtual tree and adds the logs straight to the network as data. Each vanilla tree type has its own yield.

Speed Components I–IV make many machines, including this one, work faster.
guide.industrialcrops.matter.slimes.body:
Right-click a slime with a Slime Conversion Device to capture it. Place the device and insert an ore to convert the slime: copper, iron, gold or diamond.

Put the filled converter (or a matching spawn egg) into a Slime Cultivation Device. It produces resources continuously: slime balls, copper, iron or gold ingots, and Component Substrate from the diamond slime.
guide.industrialcrops.carrote.carrote.bo:
The digitizer's tooltip whispers: try an Industrial Carrot. Do it only when you are ready.

Uploading Industrial Carrots overloads the Matter Digitization Device: it explodes and is destroyed, you drop to 1 health with the Glitch effect, and every carrot becomes a Carrote. Build a spare digitizer first and stand somewhere safe.
guide.industrialcrops.carrote.forge.body:
Fill a cauldron with lava and right-click it with a Carrote. The cauldron turns into a Paradox Steel Forge.

Put Carrotes and Netherite Ingots into the forge. Each cycle takes 5 seconds and turns one Carrote and one alloy ingot into a Paradox Steel Ingot. Nine ingots make a Paradox Steel Block.
guide.industrialcrops.carrote.paradox_de:
Wrap a Paradox Steel Ingot in Polished Blackstone to make the Paradox Steel Device Casing.

• Matter Hardening Device: makes an inserted item unbreakable.
• Universal Replication Device: place it left of an energy device to create an independent copy of it.
• Mimic Block: place it left of a block; after five seconds it becomes that block.
guide.industrialcrops.carrote.stable_mat:
Upload a Paradox Steel Ingot through the Matter Digitization Device. Its data settles into Stable Matter, which a Matter Reconstruction Device can rebuild as Stable Matter Ingots.

Stable Matter is used for Mimic Blocks and, together with a Fusion Melon, for the Fusion Ingot: the final material of this manual.
guide.industrialcrops.curios.finding.bod:
More than twenty Carrote accessories hide in village chests. Each one grants a single ability: extra damage, flight, night vision, a damage shield, peaceful surroundings, better loot and more.

A Carrote works in your main hand, offhand or any Carrote slot when Curios is installed. Identical effects do not stack. Hold Shift over a Carrote to read its exact effect.
guide.industrialcrops.curios.equipping.b:
The Helmet Carrote goes in your head slot and copies one other Carrote: first from the Carrote slot, then from your offhand. It shows Not copied when the copy would add nothing.

The Ultimate Carrote is a pouch. Right-click to store Carrotes inside; while it sits in your offhand or an accessory slot, every Carrote stored in it or carried in your inventory is active.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.satelli: Directs satellites in orbit to mine in space. Needs a powered Satellite Signal Receiver and an Item Network Management Terminal within 8 blocks; mined ore goes into the terminal. Uses 200 FE/t while mining.
gui.industrialcrops.satellite_control.re: Reached by: crystal steel (small), medium and large satellites
Reached by: medium and large satellites
gui.industrialcrops.satellite_control.lo: Locked: no satellite in orbit can reach it
A satellite wore out and burned up
gui.industrialcrops.satellite_control.st: Place a satellite receiver within 8 blocks
Place a network terminal within 8 blocks
No satellite can reach this area
guide.industrialcrops.crystal.space_mini:
Every satellite rocket is built with two pickaxes. The satellite's durability is the remaining durability of those pickaxes, so use fresh ones. Each space mining cycle wears one point; at zero the satellite is destroyed.

Place a Satellite Control Device with a powered Satellite Signal Receiver and an Item Network Management Terminal within 8 blocks. Open it, click a mining area on the map and press Start. The crystal steel (small) satellite only reaches area I; medium satellites reach area II and large ones area III.

Ore arrives in the terminal: Green Iron, Inv and Tycon Ore. Smelt them into ingots.
gui.industrialcrops.ultra_high_pressure_: Click a recipe to select it
gui.industrialcrops.ap.upgrade.power_hel: Power Component: −25%% FE per component (up to 3).
gui.industrialcrops.ap.upgrade.chunk_hel: Dimension Upgrade Component (either kind): keeps the whole 25×25 working area loaded.
gui.industrialcrops.ap_agriculture.upgra: Speed Component I–IV: plants up to 4 seeds per tick and adds 2 growth ticks per boost level for each tier.
Automatic Component: harvests ripe crops (seeds refill the seed row, produce goes to the output row) and pushes the output row into adjacent containers.
gui.industrialcrops.ap_livestock.upgrade: Speed Component I–IV: work cycle every 0.75 / 0.5 / 0.35 / 0.25 s instead of every second.
Automatic Component: pushes the output row into adjacent containers every second.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.ap_stru: Compact storage for 9 AP Structural Steel. Works as a beacon base and caps every AP multiblock.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.inv_blo: Compact storage for 9 Inv Ingots. Works as a beacon base.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.tycon_b: Compact storage for 9 Tycon Ingots. Works as a beacon base.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.green_i: Compact storage for 9 Green Iron Ingots. Works as a beacon base.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.ap_stee: Floor block of the AP multiblocks. A 3×3 floor needs 8 casings plus the controller in the front-middle.
Corner pillar of the AP multiblocks. Stack two on each of the four floor corners (8 total).
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.ap_agri: Controller of a 3×3×3 multiblock: 8 AP Steel Casings on the floor, 8 AP Steel Frames on the corners, an Automatic Sowing Device in the centre and a Block of AP Structural Steel on top. Plants seeds on empty farmland within 12 blocks and speeds up crop growth with FE (adjustable boost). Install Speed, Power, Automatic and Dimension components in the side drawer; the holographic projection shows where every part goes.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.ap_live: Controller of a 3×3×3 multiblock: 8 AP Steel Casings on the floor, 8 AP Steel Frames on the corners, an Automatic Animal Breeder in the centre and a Block of AP Structural Steel on top. Breeds, shears, culls and raises livestock within 12 blocks and collects the drops. Named and tamed animals are never touched. Install Speed, Power, Automatic and Dimension components in the side drawer; the holographic projection shows where every part goes.
gui.industrialcrops.ap.help.title: How to build (3×3×3)
gui.industrialcrops.ap.help.1: Floor: controller in the front-middle, 8 AP Steel Casings around it.
gui.industrialcrops.ap.help.2: Corners: 2 AP Steel Frames stacked on each floor corner.
gui.industrialcrops.ap.help.4: Centre, 2 blocks up: Block of AP Structural Steel.
gui.industrialcrops.ap_livestock.breed.t: Breeds pairs of each species with feed from the feed row (feed bags work too) until the cap is reached.
gui.industrialcrops.ap_livestock.shear.t: Shears every sheep with wool; the wool goes to the output row.
gui.industrialcrops.ap_livestock.cull.ti: Slaughters adults above the cap so pens never overflow. Drops go to the output row.
gui.industrialcrops.ap_livestock.grow.ti: Spends FE to make babies grow up faster.
